correctness.rationale: The theorem derives Algorithm 1 exactly at constant damping and positive scalar l1 penalty. The Schur inequalities prove bounded input-stable subcritical dynamics, while soft-threshold deadzone gives local exponential attraction at all curvature ratios. For \(k>1+((2-a)/a)^2\), direct substitution determines the only antipodal cycle and an exact invariant cone whose positive two-by-two transfer matrix has Perron eigenvalue above one; diagonal-start entry gives exponential escape. The equality case and other periodic cycles are excluded explicitly. Package checker.py passed 160 exact-rational parameter cases.

value.rationale: A sharp global-boundedness versus explicit source-start escape frontier for the actual nonsmooth semi-implicit method, plus an explicit finite-amplitude antipodal orbit coexisting with a locally attractive minimizer, exposes a genuine limitation of local proximal identification as a global numerical stability diagnostic.
